description: A modern C#-like language and zero-cost 2D framework for Game Boy and NES
releaseNotes:
# Changelog 0.0.1240

## Changes since v0.0.1231

- Templates teach the user and their agent: four-direction minimal with a scene, guide pointers, warning-free builds (#2337) (#2365) (`ad2222a6`)
- Game Boy: the screen backdrop takes the scene's backgroundcolor (#2360) (#2363) (`3daa955b`)
- A program without a scene shows the same white backdrop on every target (#2346) (#2361) (`28f286b5`)
- SDK: World is now Scene for developers (#2352) (#2359) (`e692a58a`)
- retrosharp guide debug: the agent knows it needs the debugging MCP servers and how to install them (#2356) (#2358) (`d8894003`)
- templates create accepts an existing empty destination, including . (#2345) (#2357) (`63d14f0e`)
- Target diagnostics name the call as written, its line and target, and what to write instead (#2344) (#2355) (`3a93431d`)
- retrosharp guide: the game-maker docs and art-free examples from the installed CLI (#2351) (`34e75162`)
- Static methods of a class can have target variants (#2343) (#2349) (`011f06f2`)
